1.58.betting_forecast: 13/8 Lexington Wood, 5/2 Way Maker, 7/2 Kibris, 11/2 Scriabin, 14/1 Sonyourastar, 20/1 Struth, 33/1 Etretat, Hawthorn Road,
1.58.spotlight_verdict: This is significantly easier than the Grade 2 LEXINGTON WOOD tackled on his hurdle debut and he's preferred to last summer's dual bumper winner Way Maker. Scriabin has the form to figure, while Kibris could also have a big say if bouncing back to form after a stable switch. [Andrew Sheret]

horses.spotlight_comment: Signs of only a little ability so far and will need to find significant improvement for the addition of a tongue-tie.
horses.trainer: R Michael Smith R Mike Smith
horses.breeding: b m Berkshire - Peace And The City

horses.spotlight_comment: Failed to beat a rival in two bumpers last season; big outsider now hurdling.

Fairly useful four-time AW Flat winner for Charlie Johnston but 0-17 on turf for that yard; ran poorly at Lingfield (AW) 16 days ago and changed hands for 1,000gns since; best watched on hurdles debut.
125-1, well held on course bumper debut (good) 20 days ago; can only watch now hurdling.
horses.trainer: Simon Munir & Isaac Souede S Crawford (IRE)
horses.breeding: b g Lope De Vega - Dark Rose Angel

horses.spotlight_comment: Pulled up having lost ground quickly when 5-2 joint favourite for a Musselburgh bumper in December; hooded when modest seventh of 13 in another bumper at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) 12 weeks later; not an obvious one to strike on hurdles debut.

Useful Flat winner at the start of his career but failed to progress in juvenile hurdles last season after a promising start; also well held back on the Flat at the Curragh six weeks ago (final start for Joseph O'Brien); more than capable of making his presence felt in a race like this if putting his best foot forward but starts out for a new yard (same owners) with a point to prove.

Well held in both bumpers last season, although the fact he was sent off at 5-2 for the first one suggests he must have been showing some promise at home; has had wind surgery ahead of this hurdles debut after two months off.

Showed promise in three Irish bumpers last year, after which he was sold for £105,000; novicey jumping, in at the deep end, on his hurdles debut in a Grade 2 at Kempton (2m, good to soft) when eighth of ten finishers in February; sure to have been well schooled since and could be a different proposition here.
Poor form in seven outings over hurdles and needs to show significant improvement in a first-time hood.
horses.trainer: Geoff And Elspeth Adam N Alexander
horses.breeding: b g Yeats - Daisies Adventure

horses.spotlight_comment: Scudamore Patrick Wadge 11-2 104 105 114 Ex-Irish; 12-race maiden over hurdles but placed in three of his four for current yard, last time finishing third of 12 in C&D handicap (good) 21 days ago; each-way claims again.
horses.trainer: D G Pryde & William Pryde L Russell & M Scudamore
horses.breeding: b g Fly With Me - Starlin

horses.spotlight_comment: Reached the frame in three 3m Irish points; well-held fourth on 2m4f Market Rasen hurdles debut (good to soft) in March but it was an okay race, with the three ahead of him all successful since; down in trip now; Sean Bowen on the yard's other runner.

Scudamore Gregor Walkingshaw (10) 20-1 96 82 108 Useful on the Flat in his prime but has yet to better fair form over hurdles, weakening into a well-held fifth on 2m2f Kelso handicap debut in this sphere 24 days ago; might have needed that after a break but he's still hard to make a good case for.
horses.trainer: Mrs S Russell L Russell & M Scudamore
horses.breeding: br g Walk In The Park - Carrigeen Kigelia

horses.spotlight_comment: Won bumpers at Bangor (good) and Stratford (good to firm) last summer; found life tough under a double penalty in a valuable bumper at Newbury back from a break in March but remains a good hurdles prospect, particularly for this time of year.

2.33.betting_forecast: 5/4 Largy Force, 7/2 Busty Boy, Inis Oirr, 9/1 Ned Tanner, 12/1 Red Happy, 14/1 Cosmic Blizzard.
2.33.spotlight_verdict: This looks a good opportunity for LARGY FORCE (nap) to land a third win since joining Olly Murphy. Last month's Highland National runner-up Busty Boy looks the most solid option for the forecast spot. [Andrew Sheret]

horses.spotlight_comment: Only 1-22 under rules and clearly hard to win with but he arrives in form having placed in a second successive Highland National here (3m6f, good) last month; just as effective over this shorter distance.
horses.trainer: Scott Lowther D Bourke
horses.breeding: ch g Ivawood - Alexander Divine

horses.spotlight_comment: Scudamore Patrick Wadge 14-1 107 119 125 Ex-Irish pointer; good second in a Kelso novice handicap chase (2m7f, good) last autumn but has pulled up on his two outings since (reportedly bled latest); something to prove.
horses.trainer: County Set Four & L V Russell L Russell & M Scudamore
horses.breeding: b g Arctic Cosmos - Tara Belle

horses.spotlight_comment: Scudamore Gregor Walkingshaw (10) 7-2 108 112 125 Back to form a little out of the blue to take advantage of a reduced mark over C&D (good) under Gregor Walkinshaw three weeks ago; remains well treated on old form (won 2024 Edinburgh National off 11lb higher) but not sure to be in the same mood again based on his recent record.
horses.trainer: Gerry McGladery L Russell & M Scudamore
horses.breeding: b g Ocovango - Peace Time Beauty

horses.spotlight_comment: Progressive mare who has form figures of 21212 since joining Olly Murphy; edged out by a next-time-out winner (pair 19l clear) at Uttoxeter (3m, good to soft) last time and still looks well treated after a 3lb nudge.
horses.trainer: Foxtrot Racing Largy Force O Murphy
horses.breeding: br m Workforce - Aunt Rosalie

horses.spotlight_comment: Dual winner over 2m4f on soft ground in 2024-25 season but has been rather inconsistent and didn't offer enough when fifth of seven over C&D (good) three weeks ago to suggest he's likely to cash in on his reduced mark now.
horses.trainer: Hands And Heels N Alexander
horses.breeding: b g Milan - Rose Tanner

horses.spotlight_comment: Completed a hat-trick at around 3m in February/March 2025 but not seen again until refusing to race when a 20-1 shot at Kelso 24 days ago; can only watch after that.
horses.trainer: Gibson, Annett And Mandle G Bewley
horses.breeding: ch g Red Dubawi - Happynees

3.08.betting_forecast: 15/8 Moyganny Phil, 4/1 Bold Light, Sun Art, 8/1 Summergrounds, 10/1 Easy To Follow, 12/1 Follow Charlie, 14/1 Dalileo, 16/1
3.08.spotlight_verdict: Olly Murphy saddles three - Easy To Follow, Carismatic Soldier, and MOYGANNY PHIL - and it is unsurprising that Sean Bowen takes the mount on the last named of that trio. The 6yo won at Carlisle over Easter, and might have got off lightly with just a 2lb rise. Bold Light is a potential threat, while Sun Art would have claims if fully effective beyond 2m. [Mark Rowntree]

horses.spotlight_comment: Scudamore Alan Doyle (3) 4-1 116 95 121 Won a Class 2 at Kelso (2m5f, good to soft; from 7lb higher) in March 2025, but has failed to match that level of form since (0-9); wasn't beaten too far over C&D (Class 3; fourth of seven) three weeks ago, and a similar effort would give him a shout in this added tongue-tie; 2-10 for Alan Doyle.
horses.trainer: T Carruthers L Russell & M Scudamore
horses.breeding: ch g Leading Light - Turmoss

horses.spotlight_comment: Made a promising start over hurdles, keeping on well to score at Chepstow (2m novice, heavy; 6-5) in January 2025; failed to progress handicapping (0-6) and continues to ease in the weights, tried in various forms of headgear; soundly beaten here (3m2f) on Wednesday.
horses.trainer: Aj Wall, Briton International & Partners O Murphy
horses.breeding: b g Soldier Of Fortune - Lady Charisma

horses.spotlight_comment: Three-time Perth winner (2m4f-3m) who is back on his last winning mark and should have the ground (good) to suit; late headway when fourth of 14 at Ayr (2m4f, soft) last November but well beaten here on Wednesday on his first run since.
horses.trainer: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing Miss L Harrison
horses.breeding: b g Galileo - Snow Queen

horses.spotlight_comment: On the rise for previous yard in late 2023, winning back-to-back at Uttoxeter (maiden) and Fontwell (novice); mostly disappointing over fences (0-5), pulling up at Huntingdon in January when last seen; back to hurdles from fair mark on first start for Olly Murphy; consult the market.
horses.trainer: Foxtrot Racing Easy To Follow O Murphy
horses.breeding: b m Arcadio - Wings At Dawn

horses.spotlight_comment: 4-29, including a C&D win (from 2lb lower) at this two-day Perth fixture in 2025; has been competing over 3m recently, failing to get home when fourth to Suspected (beaten over 13l) here three weeks ago; dropping back in trip is in his favour; don't discount hastily.
horses.trainer: Riverside Racing R Mike Smith
horses.breeding: b g Court Cave - Lucyintheskywith

horses.spotlight_comment: Former pointer; consistent over hurdles, ridden out to see off big-priced rival at Carlisle (2m4f, good to soft; 7-4 joint-favourite) over Easter; fairly treated off this 2lb higher mark and, with the prospect of more to come, rates as the pick of the Olly Murphy trio.
horses.trainer: Premier Plastering (uk) Limited O Murphy
horses.breeding: b g Califet - Moyganny Lass

horses.spotlight_comment: Runner-up twice over C&D in 2025 and filled that same position behind Kingston Narcissus at Sedgefield (2m4f, good to soft) on Boxing Day; pulled up on return from break at Ayr (2m4f, soft) latest; may strip fitter, and it's a positive that Danny McMenamin is back aboard.
horses.breeding: b g Phoenix Reach - Hannah Jacques

horses.spotlight_comment: Won in first-time tongue-tie at Ludlow (2m, novice; good) in March 2025; placed in three of his five starts since, runner-up to the 13-8 favourite Wild Goose at Hereford (2m, good) four weeks ago; stamina not yet proven over 2m4f; possible.
horses.trainer: Imperial Racing Partnership F O'Brien
horses.breeding: b g Masked Marvel - Lexus Du Charmil

3.43.betting_forecast: 13/8 Kado Sacree, 11/4 Atlantic City, 9/2 Lets Mingle, 12/1 Annie Agnew, Kinbara Firstdraft, Largy Meadow, 14/1 Sauce Of Life,
3.43.spotlight_verdict: Continuing a common theme, Olly Murphy holds the key with both Atlantic City and KADO SACREE bidding to make it 2-2 in handicap company. The former has been raised 5lb for her C&D win, while her newly tongue-tied stablemate is up a more modest 3lb for Carlisle. Of the remainder, granted a clear round, Lets Mingle could give that duo the most to think about. [Mark Rowntree]

horses.spotlight_comment: Game Down Royal winner; runner-up (no match for winner) over 2m here in June 2024; blown more cold than hot since, pulling up over 3m at Down Royal last October; easing mark but with a bit to prove at present, especially off a 195-day absence.
horses.trainer: Caherty Stables Racing Syndicate G Quinn (IRE)
horses.breeding: b m Sir Percy - Famusa

horses.spotlight_comment: Form figures since leaving Ciaran Murphy read 21; produced late to make winning handicap debut over C&D (good; 4-1, from 5lb lower) three weeks ago; James King retains the mount with Sean Bowen booked to ride stablemate Kado Sacree; contender.
horses.trainer: Deva Racing (DB) O Murphy
horses.breeding: ch m Ulysses - Roulette

horses.spotlight_comment: The handicapper has cut him slack, and he sits 1lb higher than when winning readily at Carlisle (2m4f, soft) last November; modest this year, flattering briefly before two out over C&D on Wednesday.
horses.trainer: The Cheltenham Trail M D Hammond
horses.breeding: b g Getaway - Grange Oscar

horses.spotlight_comment: Point winner; left previous rules efforts behind, ridden out to make winning handicap debut at Carlisle (2m4f, good to soft; 11-10 favourite) over Easter; that wasn't a particularly deep race, so a 3lb rise is fair; prospect of more to come in newly applied tongue-tie; stablemate of Atlantic City.
horses.trainer: Premier Plastering (uk) Limited O Murphy
horses.breeding: gr g Magneticjim - Fleur Sacree

horses.spotlight_comment: Won twice over hurdles, including here (2m, good to firm; from 9lb lower) in June 2024; hasn't really taken to fences (0-3), only fourth of six at Ayr (2m, soft) three months ago; this return to hurdles could reignite a spark, but it's likely he's a few pounds too high in the handicap.
horses.trainer: Jetmac Syndicate S Crawford (IRE)
horses.breeding: ch g Koropick - Kimberely Bay

horses.spotlight_comment: Patiently ridden and bustled up the winner (Camarrate) at Newcastle (2m4f, good; from 2lb lower) on penultimate start; pulled up over C&D subsequently; still low mileage, so isn't a forlorn hope if bouncing back from that blip.
horses.trainer: R Michael Smith R Mike Smith
horses.breeding: b g Soldier Of Fortune - Ballinahow Star

horses.spotlight_comment: Scudamore Jack Power (5) 9-2 113 97 115 Short-odds C&D maiden winner (four ran) this time last year; form figures since introduced to handicapping read 243U, still bang there when unseating her rider at the last over C&D recently; good ground plays to strengths; possibilities despite going up 4lb.
horses.trainer: Tay Valley Chasers Racing Club L Russell & M Scudamore
horses.breeding: b m Walk In The Park - Thessalienne

horses.spotlight_comment: Unbeaten in bumpers (2-2) and very lightly raced for his age; seldom seen in action since winning by a neck at Doncaster (2m4f, good to soft; from 3lb lower) in December 2024; fitness is taken on trust but it's noted that connections persevere for the time being.
horses.trainer: Mrs I C Sellars And Miss D C Sellars N Richards
horses.breeding: b g Califet - Salsaparilla

horses.spotlight_comment: No win over hurdles since July 2021, and was a remote last of eight in this last year; solid record over fences here - four wins at 3m - which does at least offer some hope, even if he has struggled for form (P84) in his last three starts; might need this off a 232-day absence.
horses.trainer: Abbadis Racing & D A Harrison Racing Miss L Harrison
horses.breeding: ch g Spirit One - Linda Queen

4.18.betting_forecast: 5/4 Trust House, 4/1 Castle Ivers, 13/2 Oh Janey, 8/1 Just Dottie, Magnolia, 10/1 Double Oban, 12/1 Pure Gold.
4.18.spotlight_verdict: Last year's winner Just Dottie returns but this looks a far more competitive renewal. Olly Murphy holds all the aces with hat-trick seeker TRUST HOUSE, who arrives in much better form than stablemates Castle Ivers and Double Oban. Of the others, Oh Janey has more work to do, but she's relatively unexposed as a handicapper, so is worth considering. [Mark Rowntree]

horses.spotlight_comment: Looked useful when winning a Wetherby bumper by 7l in March 2024; hurdles career off to a perfect start at Warwick (2m, good to soft) the following season, but absent for 18-plus months thereafter until reappearing at Ayr (4-1 favourite; tailed off) recently; now sits 2lb lower.
horses.trainer: Bective Stud O Murphy
horses.breeding: b g Malinas - Made Easy

horses.spotlight_comment: 5-11 over hurdles but the bulk of those wins have come on soft or heavy ground; sits 4lb higher than when winning at Leicester (2m, soft; 9-4, four runners) over Christmas; one of three declared runners for Olly Murphy.
horses.trainer: Dydb Marketing & Briton International O Murphy
horses.breeding: b g Territories - Zaaneh

horses.spotlight_comment: Won this race last year, from this mark, but with Sean Bowen in the saddle; that was her fourth Perth win and she notched again on the Flat at Ayr (1m5f, Class 5, soft) in September; recent C&D comeback run should bring her on but she has work to do with Magnolia (second) and Pure Gold (fifth).
horses.trainer: R Michael Smith R Mike Smith

horses.spotlight_comment: Both British wins have come at Kelso, comfortably seeing off Joltin And Jiving there (2m, soft; 13-8 favourite) last November; slowly edging back down the weights (2lb above last winning mark); second-best to another Olly Murphy-trained runner over C&D (25-1, beaten 11l) latest.
horses.trainer: The Magnolia Partnership M D Hammond
horses.breeding: b m Spider Flight - Ivresse Du Berlais

horses.spotlight_comment: Always doing enough when making winning handicap debut at Downpatrick (2m1f; 9-4 favourite) last October; well beaten in a Grade 3 mares' novice next time, and absent since; no issue with this track, so mildly interesting to see how she fares off a BHA mark of 109.
horses.trainer: S R B Crawford S Crawford (IRE)
horses.breeding: b m Free Eagle - Jane's Track

horses.spotlight_comment: Couldn't fault her momentum last year, rising from a mark of 88 at Uttoxeter in July to 102 when scoring readily at Hexham (2m, good to soft) in October; found life tougher in better races (Wetherby and Cheltenham) thereafter; this is equally tough, but she could strip fitter for C&D comeback run.
horses.trainer: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing Miss L Harrison
horses.breeding: b m Golden Horn - Nathalie

horses.spotlight_comment: On a hat-trick after justifying favouritism at Market Rasen and Ffos Las (both 2m); a combined rise of 16lb - 8lb for latest win - makes life more challenging as he moves into a Class 3 for the first time; however, he's improving and spearheads his yard's triple representation in this field.
horses.trainer: Bill Hawkins & Partner O Murphy
horses.breeding: b g Lope De Vega - Rococo

4.55.betting_forecast: 9/4 Tanking Along, 11/4 Carrigeen Castle, 7/2 Traveling Soldier, 5/1 Sir Carnegie, 13/2 Wings On Wheels, 25/1 Uncle Al.
4.55.spotlight_verdict: The reapplied cheekpieces could be a major positive for TRAVELING SOLDIER and he is taken to make a winning return to action. Tanking Along needs to prove his stamina but can be a threat if seeing it out, while Sir Carnegie ran well when third here yesterday.[Ben Hutton]

horses.spotlight_comment: 10yo who was in and out last season but returned to form when second at Hexham (2m4f, soft) in March last time; could have a part to play if conditions are suitable (he's unraced on good ground under rules).
horses.trainer: The Cheltenham Trail M D Hammond
horses.breeding: b g Doyen - Carrigeen Kariega

horses.spotlight_comment: He can make mistakes and may be better over further, but he won two in a row last autumn (2m7f, good/good to soft) and was back on song when runner-up here (3m, good) three weeks ago in reapplied cheekpieces (retained since); good third here (3m, good to soft) yesterday; could be in the mix.
horses.trainer: Mickey Bowen M Bowen
horses.breeding: b g Elusive Pimpernel - Sainte Careigne

horses.spotlight_comment: Made all at Sedgefield (2m, good) in March and placed on last two starts, most recently runner-up at Kelso (2m1f, good) last week; the step back up in trip poses a question but he's a leading player if seeing it out.
horses.trainer: Eamon McElligott P Neville
horses.breeding: b g Walk In The Park - Myska

horses.spotlight_comment: Didn't jump well when pulled up in first-time blinkers at Plumpton last November when last seen; however, he was in good form previously in cheekpieces and they go back on today; could have a big say.
horses.trainer: Premier Plastering (uk) Limited O Murphy
horses.breeding: b g Mahler - Asian Alliance

horses.spotlight_comment: Won off this mark in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Sedgefield in December but below par on his next three starts and he unseated early at Hexham 12 days ago; needs to get back on track.
horses.trainer: Miss J I Bedi Miss J Bedi
horses.breeding: b g Leading Light - Milling Road

horses.spotlight_comment: Point runner-up who improved upon his previous rules form when 5l second of four at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) in March when wearing first-time cheekpieces (retained) on his second chase/handicap start; this very lightly raced 7yo may have more to offer and could be involved.
horses.trainer: Ian Williams I Williams
horses.breeding: b g Pour Moi - Vintage Spirit

5.28.betting_forecast: 7/4 Sea Tempest, 9/4 Hold The Throw, 11/2 Royalty Row'D, 13/2 Killygowan, 9/1 Saint Cunning, 11/1 Ballynulto, 50/1 Clova
5.28.spotlight_verdict: The vote goes to SEA TEMPEST on the back of his promising debut but a strong market move for Olly Murphy Irish point recruit Hold The Throw would put a slightly different slant on things. Newcomers Royalty Row'd and Stuart Crawford pair Killygowan and Saint Cunning would also enter the reckoning if the betting speaks in their favour. [Andrew Sheret]

horses.spotlight_comment: Remote third on his completed start in Irish points but the fact his trainer has a 5-12 bumper record in British bumpers in the last five seasons, including a win in this in 2024, means he needs monitoring in the betting.
80-1 when well beaten on his debut in a bumper at Ayr Scottish Grand National meeting; has a tongue-tie added this time.
25-1, pulled up after hanging badly left on his Market Rasen debut 39 days ago; can only watch after that.
Bought for £72,000 after finishing second in a 3m Irish point last November; has joined a leading stable with a healthy bumper strike-rate, including 2-6 here; obvious appeal.

15,000euros 3yo; half-brother to winners Hurricane Dylan (2m4f-2m6f hurdle/chase) and Mountain Philip (2m7f chase); dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Darceys Dancer; Irish stable has a good 10-54 record in bumpers at Perth; probably the yard's first string here based on jockey bookings.

Brother to useful 2m3f hurdle/2m4f chase winner Raglan Road; dam 1m5f Flat winner (RPR 78), half-sister to 1m4f Listed Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner Aklan; newcomer from a stable which saddled a 1-2 in a C&D bumper last month; market informative.

45,000euros half-brother to point winner Brave Starlight; dam unraced half-sister to some useful winner; Killygowan might be the stable first string on jockey bookings but this one still needs checking out in the betting.
Related to several useful performers and he shaped very nicely when a close third at Southwell (soft; 6-1) 12 weeks ago, doing his best work late on; open to improvement and may be the answer.
